title: Salesforce Business Analyst
text: Salesforce Business Analyst at Mason Frank International (Melbourne, ; Contract/Temp; salary: $600 - $700 p.d.). Salesforce Business Analyst A leading Salesforce end user is currently seeking a Salesforce Business Analyst to lead their expanding Salesforce platform. Based in Melbourne, this will be a 6 month contract opportunity offering an exciting incentive package. Responsibilities include: • Developing and creating customized reports and dashboards • Proven Salesforce.com experience as a Business Analyst • Demonstrated experience in system testing, user acceptance testing and end to end testing. • Extensive experience in requirement gathering and documentation, with translation to other forms of project documentation such as functional specification or test scripts. • Creating and managing complex workflow rules, data validation, and triggers. • Excellent Communication skills both written & verbal. • Experience with Salesforce & multiple systems is essential Mason Frank International is the global leader in Salesforce recruitment. If you desire a change and wish to join one of Australia’s best send all inquiries or your CV to: a.elhouli@masonfrank.com or contact me for a confidential conversation on (03) 8658 0783
